_note: Reviewed IANA zone per pilot birthplace. The zone is the frame the site's own chart engine uses for an unknown-time birth (12:00 civil time at the birthplace), resolved through the complete tzdb history via Intl — which for pre-standardisation births is the zone's local mean time, not the settlement's own meridian. Each zone below is the unambiguous modern zone containing the Wikidata birthplace entity; the residual meridian difference is measured per person in computed/{slug}.json.
